params.prompt: Cinematic photoreal 3D render, square 1:1, dark warm palette (#0B0907 shadows), matte dark materials with thin brass edge accents, subtle yellow (#FDD506) accent glow, thin haze, golden dust in the light, shallow depth of field. No people, no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. In the lower 60% of the frame: a row of twelve small dark matte square tiles like a monthly calendar strip laid on a dark desk in 3D perspective, receding slightly to the right; the first tiles are empty and dim, the later tiles each carry a small glowing yellow (#FDD506) check mark that grows brighter toward the end, the last tile brightest; above the strip a small brass magnifying glass hovers over the last tile. The upper 40% of the frame is nearly black and empty for typography.
